name: undoes and redoes insertions and deletions in order
input: an insertion followed by a middle deletion
test:
doc = TextDocument('abc')
doc.insert(1, 'XY')
assert doc.get_text() == 'aXYbc'
assert doc.delete(2, 4) == 'Yb'
assert doc.get_text() == 'aXc'
assert doc.undo()
assert doc.get_text() == 'aXYbc'
assert doc.undo()
assert doc.get_text() == 'abc'
assert doc.redo()
assert doc.get_text() == 'aXYbc'
assert doc.redo()
assert doc.get_text() == 'aXc'

name: new edits clear redo and no-op edits create no history
input: undo followed by a replacement edit
test:
doc = TextDocument('hello')
doc.delete(0, 1)
assert doc.undo()
doc.insert(5, '!')
assert doc.get_text() == 'hello!'
assert not doc.redo()
assert doc.delete(3, 3) == ''
doc.insert(0, '')
assert doc.undo()
assert doc.get_text() == 'hello'
assert not doc.undo()
